balls.text: yorker, perfect, Russell can only dig it out. They scurry across for one and Kolkata Knight Riders finish on 185 for 6
just past cover! Full and wide. Russell reached out and drilled it past cover. David at long off can't cut it off this time
slower ball bouncer outside off. Slapped it to long off. Turned down the single! Suryakumar has a chat with the umpire about a possible review for the shoulder-height call from the umpire
full ball around off. Clears the front leg, swings across the line, and gets it past the square leg fielder for a boundary
overpitched outside off. Russell swings at it but inside edge to short fine. This was a slower-ball yorker that Meredith was attempting
Narine hands Russell the strike. Around the stumps. Slower ball angling in. Narine tried to hammer it leg side but the shot is toe-ended to the keeper's left
Jansen concedes 53 in four overs as this is a single to long off. Narine came down the track for a leg-side swipe but toe-ended the shot back past the bowler
good length ball, again very wide outside off. Narine lets it go and collects the extra run
wayward. Very wide outside off, and Narine gets a wide first ball
simple one for long on. Rinku tries to flat-bat this length ball over long on, but this is flat and straight to the man there. Against Yash Dayal, this went over the sightscreen
length ball, quite wide outside off with Rinku not chasing after it this time.
attempts a slower-ball yorker. Dips on Russell around off and he mistimes his slog on this occasion. On the bounce to deep midwicket
short ball around leg. Russell moves to the leg slide and slaps it high over short third for four more
that's gone! Not quite a slot ball, but Russell moved to the leg side, cleared his front leg, and then hammered it between long on and deep midwicket
good length ball around leg. In Russell's zone so he goes for the pull. But he's beaten!
Rinku thought it was a wide so let it go. But the umpire disagrees, probably rightly so. Rinku doesn't review. Slower ball from Meredith on a good length and angling across
yorker attempted around middle. Very nearly perfectly executed. Rinku tries the lap sweep, misses, and the LBW appeal is turned down. They don't review, and its probably missing off stump
full ball, around off. Meredith was searching for the yorker there. Drilled to wide long on
Russell welcomed with a short ball around off. He ducks under it.

taken at short third by Jansen. Meredith went full around leg. Iyer turned his stance to play a reverse scoop over short third. Doesn't get the elevation. Venkatesh Iyer gone for a magnificent 104. An innings of pure intent.
more streaky runs as Meredith overpitches outside off. Iyer attempts a drive. And this has taken an edge as a full toss. Goes between keeper and short third

another wild swing and Rinku is lucky this time. Full and quite wide. Rinku moved to the off side and tried to hammer a shot across the line. Inside edge, past the diving keeper, not much you can do with that kinda shot
wild swing of the bat, and bottom-edge to Kishan on the bounce. Short ball outside off and Rinku tried to drag a pull

First IPL hundred for a KKR batter since McCullum's 158! The KKR jinx is broken and that's a maiden T20 hundred for Venkatesh Iyer. Back of a length outside off and a cut slapped to point. He has a wide grin, Rinku congratulates him.
Rinku moves to the off side even before the ball is delivered. Jansen goes length and wide outside off. Rinku guides it to point and is disappointed he couldn't do more with that
full ball. slightly wide. Rinku opens the bat's face and guides it to deep third. But David, who has been terrific all afternoon, runs around from deep point to dive and stop the boundary
moves to 99. Jansen's delivery has been struck towards deep point
Chawla finishes with 1 for 19. Fullish around leg, turning towards middle and off. Blocked
fullish around leg. Moves to the leg side and plays it to square leg. Moves to 98
dot. full ball on middle, and the drive is toe-ended towards cover
good length around off. Slapped down the track for a single
enough playing around from Rinku. Chawla tosses it up around off and Rinku quickly gets down the track and converts it into a full toss. Hammered through cover thereafter
fullish ball on middle. Turning to off. Fended to the off side
Shokeen finishes with 2 for 34. Fullish ball around off and tapped towards cover point
low full toss around off. Driven to wide long off for a single
good length ball around off. Flicked off his pads to deep midwicket for a single
full ball on middle. Rinku pushes it to the leg side but Shokeen runs behind the ball
full ball around middle, and flicked in front of square to the man in the deep
full ball around off. Rinku guides a gentle dab towards point for a single
full ball around middle, from around the stumps. Clipped to deep backward square leg
length ball around leg. Flicked to deep square leg for a single
into the nineties! Short ball, pace off - only 117kph. Venky shaped up for the pull, then waited an extra half second, and then hammered it high to deep square leg
full ball around off and he throws his bat at it. Gets enough wood behind it to get the shot to wide long off
good length all around middle. Slower ball too. Bunted back to Meredith. Came over the stumps this time
around the stumps. Full ball around off and Rinku's drive goes to deep extra cover. He wanted to play it straighter than where it eventually went
full ball around off and tapped towards deep cover for a single

full ball around off. Gets low and attempts the slog sweep. Tilak this time runs in, half-dives forward, and takes a catch rather low. Shardul begins to walk back and Tilak looks confident but the umpires want to look upstairs.
guided off his pads past short fine leg. Deep square leg has to run around and intercept
half-tracker angling in and he pummels a pull in front of square. But once again terrific fielding there to slide and stop the four

dropped at deep cover! Iyer went charging at this full ball and tried to loft it over cover. But the turn make the ball fly to Tilak at deep cover instead.  He had to cover a lot of ground though, and in the end it proved to be too much
they pinch a single
Loud appeal as Venkatesh looks to ramp a short ball outside off that was angling in on him. Kishan thought there was some bat on it. Suryakumar thought about it, but they have decided not to review
On a length around off, Shardul punches it down the ground past the bowler
On a length on leg and Shardul tickles it fine for the  firstnon-Venkatesh Iyer boundary of the match
Back of a length outside off, Venkatesh backs away and dabs it past a diving point fielder. Deep third comes in to stop it at the rope
Put away with disdain! It's full on leg and he swings it over square for yet another six
Full on leg, Shardul taps it down in front on the leg-side and takes the quick single
short of length around middle. Punched back to Meredith
back of a length delivery angling into him from outside off. Cuts towards point but from close to his body
pulled with disdain! Back of a length delivery around middle. Iyer uses the angle of the ball with Meredith coming around the stumps. Pulls it to deep backward square leg
slower ball and pummeled down. Lands in the slot and even though Iyer mistimed it by a little bit, he had enough power to take it beyond the boundary. 88m six

over the stumps. Full around middle and he misses the flick. Hits the pad, and the ball rolls off side. LBW appeal and given not out. There's also been a throw from the fielder to try and catch Shardul outside his crease.  The bails are dislodged and the batters pinch a single. Mumbai choose not to review the LBW but the umpires want to check the run out
full ball around off and driven to long off for a single
full ball around leg and clipped to deep midwicket for a single
tosses it up, ends up as a full toss that Thakur sweeps for one. Protection in the deep
good length around off. Cut to deep point
half-tracker, but quick again. Punched off the back foot to the big gap at deep midwicket. But David from long on runs around and slides to stop the boundary!
Iyer moves to the leg side even before the ball is bowled. Chawla bowls a full ball around leg. Iyer tries the reverse sweep. Finds the conventional short third fielder
that's been struck to long off for a single
oh that sounded sweet off the bat. Got low quickly and picked up the full ball beautifully, hitting a slog sweep over square leg
full ball around off, and pushed towards mid off

gets to fifty but not in a convincing manner. Another inside edge that flies past the leg stump to fine leg. Iyer was in two minds and by the time the ball got to him, he simply swung his bat at random
tapped to the off side for a single

stumping chance gone? Oh yeah, Kishan can't complete this. Shokeen over the stumps bowled a length ball wide. Shardul came dancing down and couldn't get bat on ball. All Kishan had to do was grab it perfectly

oh my word! Nitish Rana is out but someone has had a go at him and he has also said something back. Oh it is the bowler Shokeen who said something to Rana, and Rana - angry already with his dismissal - has given it back. Chawla and Suryakumar get in between to cool things down. As for the wicket, Rana tried to hammer this over the long-on fielder but he mistimed it. Oh Rana was very fired up there!
full ball around leg, and pushed to the vacant area at deep midwicket for a walking single
full ball just outside leg. Attempts the sweep, misses, hits keeper's pads. Wide? Not given...
full ball around middle, and Rana sweeps magnificently behind square. But Tilak is committed 100% and puts in a dive after running around. Pulls the ball back just when it seemed to go beyond him
full on his toes and sharply clipped away to deep square leg. That was 120.4kph!
good length ball on middle. Googly is cut towards Surya at cover
full ball outside off and he drills it to wide long off. They don't consider two
two short of fifty with that slog sweep to deep backward square leg. Got down early and played it by rolling his wrists, ensuring the ball stays down
full ball around off. Iyer pushes at it, with hard hands. Ball rolls away to mid off
full ball just outside off. Gets forward to defend. Hits the bat's inside half of the pat and goes leg side
full ball drifts and lands around leg. Angles further down
full ball around off. Rana nudges it off the front foot to the leg side
full ball outside off and driven to long off
inside edge past the keeper. Around the stumps. Length ball around off. No turn this time for the offspinner but still enough questions asked
fullish on off and Rana hops back. Fended to the off side
full ball around leg. Googly takes it to off. Defended with soft hands.
full ball around off. Driven to mid off. Got forward with a big stride.

class is permanant! Chawla tosses it up and Gurbaz's eyes light up. Goes for a big heave over cover but it takes an edge. Flies to short third, fielder takes a simple one. Gurbaz was starved of strike for most of the powerplay and now he's gone.
nudges this off his pads to the leg side
full ball outside off. Gurbaz goes for the glory shot, trying to clear long off. Ball turns, takes a big edge, and Shokeen at backward point dives to take a catch. Gets a fingertip only. Dropped

KKR are rollicking and that's because of Iyer's shot-making. Length ball just outside off. Iyer takes a few steps down the track and this time his timing is spot on. Crunched over wide long off for a 16-run over
David from mid-off can't get there as Iyer tries to loft this full ball over long off. Didn't have the timing and therefore fell between mid off and long off
short ball around off and Iyer is quick to duck under it. He should probably bring the bat down too, though. Had it hanging up
fullish just outside off. Iyer looks to clip leg side. Hits his pad and rolls away. No single
airborne! Not very full around off. Iyer dances down the track and swings through the ball's line. Plenty of air time and has enough to clear the long-on boundary with a 76m six
length ball around leg. Gurbaz moves leg side and guides this down to deep third
good length ball outside off and fended off the front foot
over the stumps. Fullish ball angling into his pads. Gurbaz misses the flick, hits the outside of his pad and rolls away to square leg
good length ball outside off and he cuts in front of square. Mid off runs to his right and dives. David there

streaky boundary but he'll take 'em. Fullish outside off from around the stumps. Venky doesn't offer much footwork in his punch, and it takes an inside edge to fine leg. There was a dive in the deep but didn't come off

has Iyer hurt himself? He's hobbling. He tried something cute and the ball has crashed into him near the knee. Iyer moved to the off side to play a scoop or ramp but Green's pace beats him and the ball hits his leg instead. The physio is out and he looks in pain.
short ball around off. Iyer slashes hard at it, and the ball flies over the slip cordon. Oh its gone all the way in fact! Iyer uses his height well to play that rather comfortably
tests him with the short ball angling into the batter. Attempts the pull but mistimed. In the air briefly but lands well short of fine leg
Gurbaz coming down the track and so Green tries to follow him. But ends up getting it down the leg side

clears wide long off by a couple of rows. Tendulkar with a length ball around off. Iyer comes down the track and tries to hammer it over long off. Timing not absolutely perfect so it instead goes to wide long off.
punched off the back foot past the diving cover fielder. Length ball around off and he was quick to get into position. Relied on timing not power for the first boundary off his bat
back of a length ball outside off. 124 kph only. Iyer with a very wild swing of the bat across the line. Ball on the bounce to the keeper and not a wide either
full ball on middle and off. Iyer comfortably clips it towards Chawla at deep backward square leg
full ball going down leg stump. Tendulkar searching for the swing but this time it doesn't come off
good length ball around middle. Iyer dances down trying to hit the ball through its line, but the ball swings away slightly, and he's lucky that the off stump is still upright
fullish ball outside off. Bit of shape away and left alone by the batter
good length ball outside off and he guides it down to third man. Off the mark

terrific catch from Shokeen! Diving forward, always a chance of the ball popping out when your arms hit the floor. Green pitched it up, Jagadeesan drove on the up - a dangerous shot because of a packed off-side field - and Shokeen has dived forward from cover point to grab it. He looks confident but the umpire wants to go upstairs. There is no soft-signals in the IPL, so whatever the TV umpire says will be the final call. "Fingers under the ball," he declares... Jagadeesan out for a duck
fullish ball just outside off and guided towards point. They want one, or atleast Gurbaz does, and eventually they return. Gurbaz is actually forced to drive
and that relieves some pressure. Fullish ball that swings and lands outside leg. Going further away and Kishan's dive is futile
good length ball around off and he taps it to point where David makes a great stop by showing quick reflexes
full ball just outside off. Bit of movement away and whizzing past the batter's blades. Jagadeesan got forward to drive but the ball's shape was absolutely beautiful.
back of a length around off. Gurbaz tries to fend. Hits him on the high part of the bat and goes leg side. They pinch a single
good length ball around off and then jags into middle. Gurbaz attempts the cut but its too close to his body. Chopped to point
back of a length around leg, and Gurbaz sways away from the ball's line. 130.9kph. Can Tendulkar finish the over well?

massive appeal, the crowd goes up in unison with the bowler, but the umpire says no. Fullish ball around middle that swings into leg and hits the batter on his pads. Big discussion for DRS but not taken. Correct call, ball would've gone over the stumps
full on middle and leg. Bit of swing into the batter, who clips it past the diving midwicket fielder
is that a catch? David running back from mid on but can't make it! Tendulkar over pitches and Gurbaz's swing of the bat converts it into a low full toss. Toe-ends it high up, but clears the infield
classical left-arm seamer's delivery. Full ball outside off and angling across past Jagadeesan.
There it is, Mumbai Indians have won two-in-two and it's again David and Green at the crease. This was a much easier job for the pair, though. It's full around off and he clips it out to long-on.
Scores are level. It's a length ball on leg and he punches it back past the bowler to long-on for a single

Digs it in back of a length on leg. It was going across and Wadhera tried to steer it. KKR have reviewed this. And they have reviewed it smartly! UltraEdge confirms that he got bat on it and Wadhera has to go
On a length on off, going across him and he runs it straight of deep third and gets a boundary! Deftly played by Wadhera, using the pace of Ferguson
Full outside off, he runs it to deep third for a single
Full and wide, he cuts it away to deep backward point
On a length outside off, pace off, and Wadhere waits on it and cuts it out to deep backward point
Bangs it in short on leg, Wadhera sways out of the way as it goes across him. It's called wide for height

Looks for the ramp but edges behind. Back of a length outside off and he looked to play it over the keeper. Gets a thin edge and it's a simple take for Gurbaz. But this has been a fine, fine knock from a batter in need for some runs and he has scored those runs at a rapid pace too
Full on off, he moves across and flicks it to deep midwicket
Carved away through point. It's full and wide from Shardul and David gets his bat down and gets it in the gap
Quicker and flatter on off, David drives to cover for a quick single
Back of a length outside off, he hangs back and drives to sweeper cover
Finds the gap! Full on leg and Surya skips out and whips it away, bisecting deep midwicket and long-on

Big appeal as Surya misses a flick and is struck in front. Umpire says no and Nitish Rana reviews it. This was on a length on off and spinning in. UltraEdge shows there was no bat. But ball tracking shows the ball was just going over the stumps! SKY survives
On a length outside off, David goes back and punches it out to long-off's left
On a length just outside off, Surya goes back and whips it away to deep midwicket
Floated up on off, David looks to paddle it but misses and is hit on the front pad. Mild appeals, but the umpire wasn't interested
Bludgeoned over midwicket! This is full on fifth stump and he gets down and slogs it away for the second six of the over. This one travelled 95 metres
Short and wide and he cuts it away hard through point. Deep cover runs across to stop it from reaching the boundary rope
Full on off, David defends
On a length outside off, David goes back and drives to cover
Short ball going down leg. He has a swipe and misses. It's called wide
High and handsome from David. Tossed up full on off and he leans in and drives this over long-on
On a length outside off and David is able to play it out to sweeper cover. Suyash misses out on a wicket maiden, but finishes with excellent figures of 2 for 27
He has chopped on! Legbreak on a length on off, he went back to cut and gets an inside edge. That spun in sharply, cramping him for room. Good bowling by Suyash
Pitched up outside off, he runs it to short third
Goes for the reverse-sweep and misses. This was full outside off and Tilak wanted to hit this behind point but can't connect and loses balance
Googly outside leg, Tilak waits for this one and defends
That's a peach of a delivery from Suyash. It's tossed up full on leg, drawing Tilak Varma forward but it's a googly that spins away sharply and beats the outside edge
Full, but fired down leg. He had moved across as he looked to flick, and the umpire doesn't call a wide. Surya doesn't want to review this
And now he whips one through midwicket for four. On a length on off, and he muscles it over the midwicket fielder
This is vintage SKY! Full on off, he moves across and whips it behind square. Typical, typical Suryakumar Yadav shot
On a length on off, he taps it square to point for a single
On a length on off and Varma cuts it away hard! Beats backward point and it races away
On a length on off and going across him, Varma pulls it away to deep midwicket's left, who prevents the boundary
On a length outside off, he goes back and clips it wide of long-on
Tossed up full on off, he presses forward and defends
Pulled away behind square for four! Short on leg and he swivels and helps it along. One bounce and over the rope!
On a length outside off, he hangs back and punches it to sweeper cover
Goes for a sweep to this ball that spins away and beats his bat
Darted in full outside off, Tilak drives it to deep cover for a single
Two in a row! This is fuller outside off and he moves across abd flicks it away over midwicket. Oh, he will be happy with these last two shots!

Welcome back, Suryakumar Yadav! Remember that shot against Archer for his first international six? This is almost a carbon copy of that. It's dug in short outside off and climbing into him and he plays a lovely pickup shot over fine leg
Digs it in short outside off, Suryakumar cuts it hard but straight to backward point
Full on off, SKY backs away and drives to cover. Good fielding
Full on off and going across him again, he steers it through backward point again and this time beats the fielder. Suyash Sharma does well to run across from deep third to stop the boundary
Full on off, Tilak opens the face of the bat and guides it to backward point
Full on leg, he clips it out to deep midwicket
Imperious! Narine goes full around off, Tilak gets down and slogs this over deep square
On a length outside off, Suryakumar goes back and punches it out to sweeper cover
Full on off, Suryakumar sweeps it but finds fine leg
Tossed up full on off, SKY whips it away to wide long-on and picks up a brace
On a length on middle, Varma waits for it and whips it away to deep midwicket
Short wide and SKY is onto it immediately! Cuts it hard and beats backward point and the ball races away
Another legbreak, full on off, Tilak clips it away to deep midwicket
Sharp legbreak on a length on off, Tilak goes back and tries to whip it away but edges it onto his pads
On a length on off, Tilak goes back and steers it to short third
Nice googly on off. Tilak pressed forward to defend but it rips past the outside edge
Beats long-off. Skips out to a full delivery on off and smacks it down the ground and gets his first boundary
Clips it away to deep backward square for a single
Slower in the air and outside off, Varma comes forward and defends towards cover
Darted in on a length on middle, Tilak pulls it away behind square to the fielder in the deep for a brace

Castled! Goes for the slog sweep again, but this time he can only edge this full delivery onto his pads and then onto the stumps. He goes for 58 off 25. But he has given Mumbai Indians a great platform here
Shouts of catch, but probably only for the crowd because that's where this has landed! It's full on middle and Kishan stretches forward and slogs this hard over midwicket
Hit straight to Nitish Rana at cover. It's tossed up full and and Kishan goes for the drive. Rana thinks this is a catch and KKR review it! But replay confirms it bounced just after he hit it
On a length on middle, Kishan goes back and punches it out to long-on
Edged for four and Kishan gets his fifty! Full outside off, he goes for a drive and gets a thick edge that runs fine of third. 21-ball half-century for Kishan
Leading edge! But it falls safe. It's a legbreak on length on off and  Suryakumar gets the edge through point
Wrong'un on off, Kishan drives it out to deep point
Fired in quicker on off, Suryakumar drives it out to mid-on for a single
Low full toss on off, Kishan loses a bit of balance as he pushes it out to long-on
On a length outside off, Suryakumar drives it to cover as MI finish the powerplay on 72 for 1. This is the fourth best powerplay score this season, and MI's best of the year
On a length on off, Kishan clips it out to deep midwicket
Full outside off, he works it to long-on and gives Kishan the strike
Cut away for four! And he will be relieved with that! This was dropped short outside off and didn't need more invitation. Picks the gap between cover point and backward point
On a length on off, Surya looks to defend and gets an inside edge on to his boot and back to the bowler
On a length outside off, Kishan clips it to mid-on for a single
On a length outside off, SKY reaches for it but is beaten

Oh that's a screamer of a catch! This time it's Rohit Sharma who gets a leading edge and Umesh Yadav, who was beaten in the last ball, runs to his left and leaps to take it with both hands. This imperious opening stand is broken. The ball was tossed up full on off and Rohit pushed at it, getting the leading edge
Leading edge lands safe! Kishan goes for a slog sweep but the edge takes it just beyond mid-off running back
On a length just outside off, Rohit eases it away to wide long-on
Suyash goes full, but wide of off. Rohit goes for another sweep but inside edges it onto his back foot
And Rohit welcomes Suyash with a maximum! Full on off, Rohit sweeps it over deep square with ease
And now he gets four more.  On a length around off, Kishan makes room and swings it away over the infield
That is hit with some power! Tossed up full outside off, Kishan clears his front leg and gets down to slog it over midwicket for another biggie
Tossed up slower on leg, Kishan comes forward and pats it down
This is some imperious hitting by Ishan Kishan! Speared in full on off and Kishan dances out before muscling it over midwicket
Tossed up full on off, Kishan defends square on the off-side
Fires a full ball down leg. Gurbaz doesn't collect cleanly and allows the batters to run a bye
Picks the gap with ease! On a length outside off, spinning back into him. Rohit just goes on the back foot and punches it between cover and point
On a length on leg, Kishan looks to swipe it behind square but misses and it comes off his hips
High and mighty! Pitched up on off and Kishan skipped out to swing it over cow corner. That's gone 85 metres
Flicked away over midwicket and it races away for four. Kishan is off to a flyer here! That was on a length on leg and finishing on off and he used his wrists well to get that over the infield
Full on off, Rohit clips it to deep backward square
Heaved over extra cover! Full and wide and he frees his arms to go over the off side. The ball hits the rope on the full and it's a maximum for Rohit and MI
Umesh with a 141.3kph full ball outside off. Rohit swings at it, but is beaten
Full on middle and leg, Kishan parries it to cover point
And this time, it's all the way! In the slot outside off and Kishan carves it over cover. It's hit flat, but it lands beyond the rope. Punishes the width on offer
And this time he cuts it over point! On a length outside off and he frees his arms and slaps it away over the leaping fielder
Creaaaammmed through covers! Full outside off and Kishan gets low and drives it hard through the gap to the cover fielder's left
Full on leg, Rohit punches it out to mid-on
Drops short of deep third! it's full outside off and Kishan sliced it up in the air, but it bounces in front of the fielder running to his left
Swing and a miss! Back of a length outside off, Rohit Sharma skips out and has a go, but doesn't connect
Full on off, with a hint of shape away. Rohit defends
Full on sixth stump, Rohit backs away and flat-bats it back to the bowler
On a length on middle and off, Kishan runs it to deep third to get off the mark
On a length on middle and Kishan defends it back to Umesh
Drops him first ball? Outswinging low full toss and Rohit plonks it back at the bowler. But it lands just short!
